description: This file contains a Java class 'Test3FormatJsonPayloadToDitto' used for benchmarking or testing mapping from JSON payloads to Ditto protocol messages. It implements an interface for scenarios involving mapping messages in a connectivity service, providing setup for a JavaScript-based message mapper configured with a specific mapping script.

classes.name: Test3FormatJsonPayloadToDitto
classes.description: A Java class used for testing or benchmarking JSON payload to Ditto message mapping in a connectivity scenario.

methods.description: Returns the external message object associated with this test scenario.
